tasks.short: Establish and explain clear learning objectives

steps.what: Read current learning goals and the planned lesson, unit or project
Establish the specific objectives appropriate to the children and activity
Phrase and finish checking the selected objectives in language suitable for the children and parents or guardians

loop.purpose: Suggest clear wording for already selected learning objectives
loop.output: Plain-language objective wording linked to each selected objective
loop.check: Teacher verifies intended learning demand, meaning and accessibility; no new developmental claim or goal added
loop.why_not_simpler: Native objective templates are tried first, but audience-specific wording may require semantic rewriting

steps.what: Communicate the clear objectives to students, parents or guardians and clarify their understanding

tasks.design: Use existing objective templates in {DOCS}, with pupil goals in {OPS_SYSTEM} as the source. A bounded wording draft assists only phrasing; the teacher establishes the objectives and explains the checked version personally to children and families.
tasks.previous_blocker: Expressing a selected objective clearly for different audiences takes wording effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-grounded rewriting can offer a simpler expression without selecting the goal.
tasks.still_hard: Simpler wording can accidentally change the intended learning demand.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a suitable objective and check what the child or family understands.

ambition.what: No additional learning or communication volume claimed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6; pupil goal access and school consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded rewriting can assist wording of teacher-selected objectives while goal choice and explanation remain human.

assumptions: Boundary covers establishing, phrasing and live communication of objectives. No new objective-record commit, mass message or report is performed.

Teacher supplies selected objectives in s2; existing goal records supply goal ID and wording, with activity context from the lesson plan. Missing goals require manual selection rather than generated developmental targets.
Native templates first. Shares are provisional scenarios; only wording effort changes, including its correction and final checking in s3. Gross 6 minus 0.5 upkeep gives 5.5 net.
unknowns: Current objective templates and actual wording burden
research_questions: Does a wording draft reduce total phrasing effort while preserving the teacher's selected learning meaning?

already_counted.description: Correct and finish checking objective wording

incremental.description: Maintain objective wording instructions and examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero when native templates already suffice; up to 3% with more wording correction than central 5.5% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review existing pupil support needs, receiving-class information and current placement requirements
outputs: checked placement context and unresolved support questions

steps.what: Coordinate with family, receiving teachers and support staff about mainstream-class placement and practical support arrangements
inputs: checked placement context and unresolved support questions
outputs: proposed placement and discussed support arrangements

steps.what: Prepare the actual proposed placement record with pupil, class, start date and agreed support arrangements
inputs: proposed placement and discussed support arrangements

steps.what: Review the complete placement proposal and decide whether to authorize that placement and support arrangement
inputs: checked placement context and unresolved support questions
outputs: authorized final placement record or unresolved decision

steps.what: Commit only the authorized final placement record in the same pupil system
inputs: authorized final placement record or unresolved decision
outputs: recorded authorized mainstream-class placement; unresolved cases remain uncommitted

tasks.design: Configure native current-record references in the pupil system {OPS_SYSTEM} and placement documents in {DOCS}. The teacher coordinates the proposal and records actual arrangements; the school placement lead decides on the completed proposal before any placement is committed, with no model ranking or placement recommendation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding current support and class information can take repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native current-record views can shorten retrieval slightly.
tasks.still_hard: A possible class place may lack support that the pupil actually needs.
tasks.human_edge: Listen to family and receiving staff and keep support concerns unresolved until addressed.

ambition.what: No automated placement selection or expanded placement authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-8; pupil-data access and applicable school consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: pupil records can support placement coordination, while placement decisions require authorized human judgement.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is pupil records management. Boundary includes information review, actual coordination, proposed placement entry, existing school decision and commit. No automatic education-level decision or family message is performed.

Pupil record owner supplies current support information; receiving staff supply actual class and support availability. Teacher produces pupil ID, class ID, agreed date and support arrangements in s3; missing agreement prevents authorization.

Native references first. Shares are provisional; school placement lead's existing decision is other-role labour retained in full, not transferred savings. Focal B=90, gross=1.11%; 0.2 upkeep leaves about 0.91% net.

The same-system commit is 1% fully retained. Approval binds the complete placement proposal after it exists; changed arrangements require another school decision. Verify actual local authority before implementation.
research_questions: Can native references reduce lookup while preserving family participation and required support decisions?

already_counted.description: Check current pupil and class records

approvals.approved_version: authorized final pupil/class/date/support record from s4; unresolved or changed records cannot commit

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if records are already readily available; up to 0.5% with smaller retrieval gains than central 0.91% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare required student and activity reports

steps.what: Collect and verify the actual student records and activity observations needed for the administration's report
outputs: checked report inputs and missing-evidence list

steps.what: Arrange the student and activity facts in the required report structure
inputs: checked report inputs and missing-evidence list
outputs: structured report draft with source references

steps.what: Write the required narrative about actual students and activities using the verified observations
inputs: structured report draft with source references
checked report inputs and missing-evidence list
outputs: complete student and activity report draft

loop.purpose: Draft factual report comments from actual teacher observations
loop.input: Selected actual records, observation text and requested report topics
loop.output: Comments with source links and explicit gaps
loop.check: Teacher checks each claim, attribution, time period and tone; no inferred diagnosis, unsupported progress or invented activity
loop.stop: One redraft then manual comments; missing evidence remains missing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native report fields handle structure, but narrative observations require semantic phrasing

steps.what: Check the complete report's facts, comments, pupil scope and intended administration recipient and select the final version
inputs: complete student and activity report draft
checked report inputs and missing-evidence list
outputs: checked final report, storage location and administration recipient

steps.what: Save the checked final report in the same school document store
inputs: checked final report, storage location and administration recipient
outputs: saved final student and activity report

steps.what: Send the exact checked report to the intended internal administration recipient
inputs: saved final student and activity report
checked final report, storage location and administration recipient
outputs: submitted required student and activity report

tasks.design: Test native report templates from {OPS_SYSTEM} into {DOCS}, adding a bounded narrative draft only from actual teacher observations. The teacher checks the completed report and recipient, saves it and submits that exact version through {EMAIL}; no model invents pupil progress or diagnostic labels.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated report structure and narrative phrasing compete with record verification.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reporting and source-grounded comments can assist preparation.
tasks.still_hard: A report can sound conclusive despite incomplete observations.
tasks.human_edge: Represent actual children fairly and keep uncertainty visible.

ambition.what: No extra reporting demand or student profiling introduced.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-9; pupil-data access and applicable school consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native student report templates and source-grounded narrative drafting can assist preparation with teacher verification.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is pupil records management. Boundary includes the required report's source review, structure, narrative, final checking, storage and internal submission.

Teachers already author actual observations with pupil ID, date, activity and observation text; administration supplies report period, required fields and recipient. s1 checks sources and missing entries. If new observation capture is required, measure and add it before claiming benefit.
Native report configuration first. Shares are provisional; report source review remains retained. Final check is actual report correctness work after all comments exist, not a new approval layer.
Same-store save and short internal send each receive 1% fully retained and no saving. Gross 25.75 minus 1 upkeep yields 24.75 net. Any edit to content or recipient invalidates the corresponding gate.
unknowns: Current report automation and actual narrative correction effort
Completeness of existing dated teacher observations
research_questions: Can native templates and bounded comments reduce total preparation while preserving factual observation and uncertainty?

already_counted.description: Review report structure, narrative comments and final content

incremental.description: Maintain report mappings and review recurring comment defects

approvals.approved_version: checked final report and storage location from s4; edits void check
same checked final report and administration recipient from s4; changed content or recipient voids gate

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero when report tools already suffice or new observation capture is needed; up to 17% if correction reduces central 24.75% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain competence through professional learning events

steps.what: Attend professional meetings, educational conferences or teacher training workshops and engage with the learning to maintain or improve professional competence
inputs: actual professional meeting, conference or workshop
outputs: participation, discussed ideas and professional learning

tasks.design: Keep the teacher's actual participation in professional learning. An event summary in {LMS} may support another activity but cannot replace practice, questions and discussion in this attendance task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Professional learning requires engagement with the content and colleagues.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing learning systems provide resources without replacing actual participation.
tasks.still_hard: Judge which learning applies to the teacher's own pupils and setting.
tasks.human_edge: Ask contextual questions and learn from colleagues' actual experience.

ambition.what: No reduction in professional learning time claimed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: professional learning attendance involves active participation that an event summary does not reproduce.

assumptions: Boundary is actual attendance and engagement. The statement establishes no event booking, expense claim, authored reflection or completion-record write; no administrative baseline is invented.
Inputs are the actual event and teacher's learning questions; no new structured capture is required. Native learning resources do not remove participation.
No software change means zero upkeep; the whole task remains retained.
unknowns: Whether local professional learning includes a separate required reflection or completion entry
research_questions: Observe any actual reflection or completion record separately from event participation.

incremental.description: No introduced software or recording process

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual professional learning attendance and engagement remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Teachers retain educational goals, placement coordination and professional learning; native records and bounded phrasing assist required reports and explanations.
skills_to_grow: Verify objective and report wording against actual sources
Keep placement authority with the authorized school decision makers
role.ambitious_version: Clear goals and factual reports while classroom and placement decisions remain with people.
